concept: Photosynthesis: limiting factors, sites and the two stages (Concept 10.2)

evidence.label: Experiment
evidence.requirement: Raised the limiting input and observed its effect

evidence.label: Sites
evidence.requirement: Traced CO₂ from the stoma to the chloroplast (Concept Check 1)

evidence.label: Two stages
evidence.requirement: Tested CO₂ off and light off and saw the stages depend on each other (Concept Check 3)

evidence.label: Atom tracking
evidence.requirement: Ran both ¹⁸O experiments and placed every atom (Concept Check 2)

evidence.label: Explanation
evidence.requirement: Included the essential reasoning for both questions

evidence.label: Application
evidence.requirement: Fixed the new plant and explained why

evidence.label: Final challenge
evidence.requirement: Diagnosed at least 2 of 3 mystery chloroplasts with a justification

mastered.title: Concept mastered
mastered.body: You found the limiting input, traced CO₂ to the chloroplast, showed with isotopes that O₂ comes from water, proved the two stages depend on each other, and applied it to new cases.

developing.title: Almost there
developing.body: Most of the evidence is there, but one or more essential ideas are still missing. Try the parts marked below again.

retry.title: Needs another attempt
retry.body: The evidence does not show the concept yet. Revisit the experiment and the chloroplast and watch how each stage responds.
